channel.title: Ghost in the Patch
channel.description: Synth animism. Live-patching, learning, and listening for ghosts in the machine.
channel.itunes:author: Codekiln
channel.itunes:summary: Synth animism. Live-patching, learning, and listening for ghosts in the machine.

item.title: Undertow
item.description: A held tone on the first track, then a sub bass that sits under everything that follows. Three sequencer tracks trade loops at 58 BPM while the knobs reshape each new voice, and a growling bass takes the floor for the second half.
item.itunes:author: Codekiln

item.title: Four Lanterns
item.description: A kick, a shiny hat, a reshaped techno stab and a road of bass. Each one gets its own colored track on the Launchpad's sequencer, is caught as a loop, and keeps glowing while the next sound is summoned. Then the hat comes back on the first track and the lights dim together.

item.title: A Tiny Descant
item.description: A line of Qbit Brass goes into the Launchpad and comes back as a second voice. A tiny descant slips over it. Then the commentary mic goes quiet and the MicroFreak carries on.

item.title: four colors of inifini
item.description: Four sequencer tracks, four colors, and Infini Pad. The loops gather one at a time, then return in a changed sound.
item.itunes:author: Codekiln
item.itunes:summary: Four sequencer tracks, four colors, and Infini Pad. The loops gather one at a time, then return in a changed sound.

item.title: Infini Pad at the Crossfader
item.description: One pad, four loops, and a crossfader leaning the signal from one side to the other. Low C pedals swell under the fingers, a high G hangs over the field, and near 18:00 the transmission sinks almost to nothing before the bass climbs back in. At 28:14 the ghost speaks: a field report from the crossfader.

item.title: Infini Pad bass and 8bitfi
item.description: The Launchpad plays Infini Pad high and slow, then the MicroFreak keys turn it into a noisy bass. At 18:17 8bitfi takes over with key pressure, warbling and pitch bends over the looping pad layers.

item.title: Hallowed Speaking
item.description: The ghost made a hot appearance here for a live fall fest. Speech patches caught the vibe, gave way to swelling pads, unstable tones and filtered noise, with phrases captured and returned as overlapping audio loops.
item.itunes:author: Codekiln

item.title: NoiseBusters, Fight and TaBass
item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session with three MicroFreak factory presets in layered takes: NoiseBusters opens as a hall of mirrors, Fight comes in as a lead with pad pressure, and TaBass enters near the end as a little thumper, with cycling-envelope and filter sweeps throughout.

item.title: The Unstable over USB
item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session recorded at the library with MicroFreak preset 151 The Unstable, a slow Launchpad sequence and USB-only MIDI: Ableton Live sends the clock, Launchpad pad pressure drives the pad, and nothing needed a MIDI panic.

item.description: A Ghost in the Patch session with MicroFreak preset 016 Voidom: tracing MIDI connections and clock problems between the Launchpad Pro, MicroFreak and Ableton Live, then combining Launchpad sequencing with recorded Session clips.

item.title: GitP.26.10.11
item.description: A slow MicroFreak improvisation that moves from harmonic tones into a blurred, pitch-bent drone and closes with a virtual analog sound. Recorded in Ableton Live without spoken commentary.

item.title: GitP.26.10.07
item.description: A MicroFreak improvisation recorded in Ableton Live at 109 BPM. Its sections run from a toccata and a 90's air tune through a Casio-style passage and a sequence to a closing descan-sigh.

item.title: GitP.26.10.06 — Chords, Formants, and Sequencers
item.description: A MicroFreak improvisation starting from an initialized patch: chord oscillators, cycling-envelope and LFO modulation, and a turn toward formant sounds. Shimmering textures give way to a gruff emergence, a ballpark organ, and a trippy denouement, with the Launchpad sequencer and MicroFreak arpeggiator along the way.
